building.title: University of Auckland Clock Tower
building.note: outline: building 105's outline from the main project's campus.json (local metres east/north of origin). It is several metres off the LiDAR and is used only to choose the crop box and to draw on the heightmap figure; the frame comes from the LiDAR.

origin.note: the campus origin; local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, computed as in campus.json (lon/lat offset by 111320 m per degree)

lidar.licence: LINZ Auckland LiDAR 2024, CC BY 4.0 (via OpenTopography)

aerial.licence: LINZ Auckland Central 0.06 m Urban Aerial Photos (2023), CC BY 4.0

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6): centre = mean x/y of points higher than tower_above m; axis = principal axis of points between min_above and spine_below m high within spine_radius m of the centre (pointing north-ish); toStreet = the axis turned 90 deg, pointing west-ish (negative east).

streetview.pano_ids_note: the panoramas the Clock Tower was modelled against (2024-07 Princes St, 2025-05). With pano_ids set the run asks Google for these only; drop it to search radius_m round the building instead.
